findings.title: Batch output overwrites another input
findings.fix: Compare every proposed output with every batch input before execution, including rejected jobs and file aliases.
findings.regression_coverage: `tests/check_convert_cli.py::scenario_batch_input_protection`: earlier/later inputs, rejected input, hard link; independent items still succeed and original input hashes remain unchanged.

findings.title: CBZ error cleanup dereferences unallocated pages
findings.fix: Share null-safe page-directory cleanup across probe, allocation and expansion failures.
findings.regression_coverage: `tests/test_cbz.c`: oversized-image rejection returns `EXR_LIMIT` with null output; subsequent normal open/render succeeds; cancellation cleans a partially initialized directory.

findings.title: Manifest default overrides item overwrite:false
findings.fix: Keep CLI overwrite authorization separate from the manifest default.
findings.regression_coverage: `scenario_overwrite_precedence`: five CLI/item/default combinations, including item false overriding manifest true and CLI true overriding item false.

findings.title: NUL truncates manifest paths
findings.fix: Reject embedded NUL during manifest string parsing.
findings.regression_coverage: `scenario_manifest_nul`: input, output, ID, root, output root and field-name cases all fail before file changes.

findings.title: CBZ rejects legal short reads
findings.fix: Retry legal short reads; stop on cancellation, zero bytes or an oversized callback result.
findings.regression_coverage: `tests/test_cbz.c::source_reads`: seven-byte callbacks import successfully; invalid callbacks/cancellation return the expected error and no book ID.

findings.title: TIFF alpha is applied twice
findings.fix: Convert libtiff's packed associated RGBA to public straight-alpha byte RGBA.
findings.regression_coverage: `tests/test_image_formats.c` compares alpha and translucent color with PNG; `tests/test_cbz_formats.c::alpha_pages` compares composed pages with at most one channel-level quantization difference.

findings.title: CBZ natural-sort ties interleave member frames
findings.fix: Resolve full member-name ties before comparing frame indices.
findings.regression_coverage: `tests/test_cbz_formats.c::natural_frames`: three animated members with numeric/case ties retain member order, frame order and page IDs.

findings.title: SVG stroke margins inflate cumulative bounds
findings.fix: Measure each stroke's actual outline and union its bounds, avoiding repeated expansion of the shared box.
findings.regression_coverage: `tests/test_font_svg.c::reliability`: one versus 100 overlapping stroked rectangles produce identical pixels without artificial limit errors.

findings.title: SVG miter joins are clipped
findings.fix: Reuse canvas stroke geometry for cap/join bounds.
findings.regression_coverage: `stroke_reference`: full-page canvas comparisons for acute miters, very large miter limits and shear, plus equivalent padded/unpadded scenes.

findings.title: SVG default stroke draws outlines
findings.fix: Initialize SVG stroke to none and skip unpainted geometry.
findings.regression_coverage: Default versus explicit none, inherited versus explicit stroke, and blank default-line/no-paint comparisons.

findings.title: SVG percentage opacity is rejected
findings.fix: Parse opacity's numeric value and unit in the correct order.
findings.regression_coverage: Equivalent decimal/percentage fill, stroke and group opacity; invalid units and out-of-range values remain rejected.

findings.title: SVG root opacity is skipped
findings.fix: Traverse root paint/opacity exactly once around the selected glyph subtree.
findings.regression_coverage: Root/group equivalence, selected glyph inside defs, root glyph ID, inherited paint, root transform, zero opacity and cancellation.

findings.title: Previous chapter uses missing or stale last-page cache
findings.fix: Discover the previous chapter's final page under the current layout; clear cached endpoints on font changes.
findings.regression_coverage: Apple `ReaderModel.runSelfTest`: reopen at chapter 2, then Previous; increase/decrease font and repeat.

findings.title: Apple host turns through auxiliary EPUB parts
findings.regression_coverage: Apple self-test: skip a non-linear spine item in both directions and stop before auxiliary XHTML.

findings.title: Failed chapter turn leaves inconsistent state
findings.fix: Restore document, pager, location, frame, endpoint cache and saved progress after a failed turn.
findings.regression_coverage: Apple self-test: deferred malformed chapter leaves handles/frame, persisted position, annotation location and readable page unchanged.
